correctness.rationale: For each of the two ladder closures, every fixed coloring is bijective with a closed walk of the explicit 81-state local rung transfer: ordinary trace for the prism, rail-swapped trace for the Möbius closure. Rail-swap symmetry splits the transfer, and the exact 36-dimensional antisymmetric integer characteristic polynomial is independently reconstructed in verify.py, together with the 45-dimensional symmetric polynomial. Newton power sums yield the displayed fourth-order sequences and all-length exact signed difference. Roots of the second quartic are exactly the stated golden-ratio phases; a strict Rouché bound on the other quartic and a rigorously positive exact algebraic inequality at 16 (monotone normalized bound thereafter) establish the claimed ten-residue sign for every length at least 16; n=3..15 follow by exact recurrence. Direct explicit-neighbor exhaustive enumeration for n=3..6 independently agrees. Boundary n=3 has distinct simple edges; the result does not claim all eventual dynamics or independent external validation.

value.rationale: A single closing rail twist compares a canonical pair of equally large cubic graphs and gives a natural graph-topology response observable for local three-choice coordination/consensus equilibria. The signed difference has an exact all-size recurrence with a nonobvious ten-residue strict sign reversal and leading golden-ratio angular growth. That behavior is invisible from degree/size data and is not a routine substitution in the known binary majority seam law. The theorem is self-contained and exactly reproducible, and is a motivated equilibrium benchmark for nonlinear dynamics with boundary topology; no speculative downstream theorem or basin result is asserted.
